text:
Leila: Cottage weekend or city daytrip? Can't decide. Weather looks a little iffy — anyone up for a quick poll?
Sam: Cottage! :tent: I can bring a speaker and board games.
Anya: City for me — museum + ramen :ramen: (also indoor plants market on Sunday)
Jordan: Cottage if there's room for bikes. @Sam can you pack helmets?
Mike: I'm down for either. If cottage, can I crash on the couch? :pray:
Leila: Love the energy. Ops-Bot, can you spin up a simple poll so we don't argue forever?
Ops-Bot: Poll created — react with :one: for cottage, :two: for city. (Poll ends today 15:00)
Sam: Weather check: `Sat: mostly sunny 68F; Sun: scattered showers 60F` — link: https://weather.example.com/forecast/shoreline
Anya: Hmm if it rains I vote city. :umbrella:
Jordan: I can bring tarps and a lantern just in case. :fire:
Mike: Heads up I'll probably bring my dog unless anyone's allergic.
Leila: Dogs absolutely welcome! :dog: If cottage gets the majority by 3pm I'll book it and DM payment details.
Sam: Awesome — I'll throw my vote in. :one:
Anya: :two: (museum > muddy shoes)
Jordan: :one:
Mike: :one: but if rain ruins the bonfire we pivot to board games indoors.
Leila: Agreement plan noted. OK folks, quick final call at 3pm. Weekend logistics: who can bring coffee/eggs?
Sam: Coffee covered.
Anya: I'll bring eggs and a tiny skillet.
Jordan: I'll handle charcoal and bikes.
Ops-Bot: Reminder scheduled for 14:50 today: "Final cottage vote closing in 10 minutes"
Leila: Perfect — whoever ends up coming, see you there! :raised_hands:
